data.title: bn-93a: M0.4.4 failure taxonomy
data.description: Independent exact-head review of the committed baseline failure taxonomy, evidence traceability, frozen-rule count, cost accounting, and decision qualification.

data.body: P1: Re-adjudicate echo_reports as supported collection-level owner-note disclosures absent from the key (19 actor-level units across five findings, including pos08 Alice under the explicit any-caller claim), not unsupported object reads. Record pos09 login existence claims as two unresolved propositions counted conservatively as unsupported. The sequencing count is 2 (A=2, B=0), while 6/10 valid keeps the decision inconclusive. Correct the machine-readable reason to require both ten valid sessions and an adjudicable taxonomy.

P2: The 11 nonzero Bash results are only the outer-wrapper count. Add a separately scoped inventory/count of exit-zero tool events whose output contains underlying setup failures (masked curl 000, missing tools, parse/edit failures, wrong listener/request form), with exact transcript lines. The independent scan found 31 explicit exit-zero events; do not collapse these into the mechanical nonzero count.

P2: Bind every claim to its immutable position/arm/canonical evidence paths/digest and settled submission; deduplicate resource+action+actor tuples. Reconcile nonzero friction episodes exhaustively and reject duplicate event identities. Negative mutations that relabel pos03 evidence as pos06 or duplicate a friction line must fail.

data.reason: Changes required: echo collection disclosures are supported absent-from-key findings; login existence claims are unresolved and conservatively count as 2 unsupported; setup friction omits masked exit-zero failures; checker accepts cross-run evidence relabeling and duplicate episodes. See three review threads.

data.body: Fixed: reclassified all five echo_reports submissions as 19 SUPPORTED_ABSENT_FROM_KEY collection-disclosure units (A=15, B=4), including pos08 Alice from the same-array response containing Bob's fresh marker. Position 9's Bob and anonymous login existence propositions are UNRESOLVED and count conservatively as exactly 2 unsupported units (A=2, B=0). The report and companion now keep the outcome inconclusive because both ten valid sessions and an adjudicable taxonomy are required, and only 6/10 sessions are valid.

Fixed: retained the exhaustive mechanical inventory of 11 nonzero outer Bash results and added a separately scoped, evidence-checked inventory of 31 distinct exit-zero setup/tool-failure events (A=16, B=15) with exact transcript positions/lines and multi-diagnosis event semantics. Five listener/request-form events and the six deliberate exclusions are documented separately.

Fixed: the checker now binds every claim to summary arm/position, canonical transcript/report paths, transcript/run/report/final-message digests, completed exit-zero run state, and final agent_settled submission; enforces per-run resource+action+actor tuple uniqueness; exhaustively scans all nonzero results; and rejects duplicate friction IDs/lines. New negative tests prove a pos03-to-pos06 evidence relabel and a duplicate masked-friction line both fail.

Remaining fix at 4cf1ff2: final-submission binding is cached per run before every claim group validates its own cited line. For position 9, replacing the login group transcript line 33316 with assistant message_end line 2009 still passes. Require every group citation to equal the canonical settled final-submission line/text, and add this exact negative mutation regression. The original pos03→pos06 and duplicate-friction mutations now fail.

data.reason: One checker gap remains: a second claim group in the same run can cite a non-final assistant message_end because final-submission validation is cached per run. Add per-group canonical final-line binding and a position-9 line-2009 mutation test.
Fresh exact-head re-review confirmed adjudication and friction fixes at 4cf1ff2.

data.body: Fixed the remaining exact-head gap: every claim group now independently binds transcript.decompressed_line to the run's canonical last assistant message_end before the per-run digest cache can skip work, asserts the cited JSON event equals that canonical event, and asserts its submitted text equals final-message.txt. Added the exact regression that mutates the position 9 login citation from 33316 to assistant message_end 2009; it now fails with 'canonical settled submission line'. All three negative tests pass.
